messages:
Aisha Bello: starting Phase 1 beta for incident-bot context bundles this week. goal is to cut “first 5 min” thrash. if your rotation wants in, reply here w/ region(s) + which incident channels.

Aisha Bello: rollout checklist (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SRE-rollout-checklist (see “incident-bot-rollout-checklist” doc)

Aisha Bello: TL;DR checklist:
- [ ] confirm channel allowlist (where bot can post)
- [ ] confirm restricted-mode channel + who has access
- [ ] enable feature flag for your rotation
- [ ] verify bot health dashboard + alert (bot latency/errors)
- [ ] agree on feedback loop (👍 useful / 👎 noisy) in #incidents threads

Rafael Mendes: +1. for beta we’re turning on deploy collector everywhere by default, config diff collector only for opted-in channels. saturation collector not yet.

Rafael Mendes: enablement snippet (if you’re managing via the oncall config repo):
```yaml
incident_bot:
  context_bundles:
    enabled: true
    allowlisted_channels:
      - "#incidents"
      - "#incidents-us-east"
    collectors:
      deploys:
        enabled: true
        window: "60m"
        max_items: 3
      config_diff:
        enabled: true
        window: "30m"
        safe_post_only: true
      saturation:
        enabled: false
  restricted_mode:
    enabled: true
    public_channel: "#incidents"
    private_channel: "#incidents-restricted"
```

Sean Gallagher: reminder: fail-open. if bot is slow / errors, it should post partial bundle + explicit “collector timed out” section, not block responders. if you see it spamming, ping here.

Platform Oncall: we’ll opt in for #incidents + #incidents-us-east. config diffs are the big gap for us. can we keep key allowlist tight (routing policies + rate limits only)?

Jacob Stein: yep. config diff collector is “safe_post_only” in beta. anything outside allowlist gets summarized as “redacted key changed” w/ audit link, no values.

SRE Oncall: opting in for #incidents-eu-west as well. deploy context alone would’ve helped 2 incidents last week.

Talia Benson: can ppl drop here who’s enabled already + which channels so I can track adoption for weekly report?

Aisha Bello: current opts (as of today):
- Platform Oncall: #incidents, #incidents-us-east (deploy + config diff)
- SRE Oncall: #incidents-eu-west (deploy only to start)
If you want in: reply w/ channel list + whether restricted-mode is set up.

Miles Thornton: pls confirm region awareness: the deploy collector needs to show last deploy per *service+region*. we’ve had incidents where only us-east was rolled.

Rafael Mendes: yep. deploy summary block is grouped by region; if region unknown it’ll say “region: unknown (check tags)” and link to deploy event.

DeployBot: (system) Deploy annotations are now available for service=router in us-east / eu-west. schema=v2.3

Aisha Bello: 👍 thanks. also: for restricted-mode incidents, public channel gets minimal metadata only (incident id + “bundle posted in restricted channel”). full context bundle goes to #incidents-restricted.

Platform Oncall: quick q: do we have a standard reaction for “bundle was useful” vs “bundle missed something”?

Sean Gallagher: use 👍 for useful, 👎 for noisy/incorrect, and 🧵 reply w/ what was missing (e.g. “need canary %”). we’re scraping reactions for signal.

SRE Oncall: enabled for #incidents-eu-west. restricted-mode ready. :thumbsup:

Talia Benson: noted.

---

Aisha Bello: week 1 check-in (drop notes here when you get a sec). looking for:
1) did bundle land in first ~2–3 min?
2) was it correct (right service/region)?
3) any noise/format issues?

SRE Oncall: had 1 incident (eu-west elevated p95) where the deploy collector was instantly helpful. it highlighted a router deploy 18m before impact + linked the GH PR. we rolled back faster than usual. 👍

SRE Oncall: formatting nit: the deploy list is a bit tall in mobile. maybe cap to 2 items by default + “show more” link?

Jacob Stein: ack. we can drop default max_items to 2 for mobile readability and include “+1 more deploy (link)”. tracking.

Platform Oncall: config diff was helpful once (routing policy change). it correctly flagged `routing.policy.variant_weights` changed + gave audit link. responders used it as the “suspect change” immediately. 👍

Platform Oncall: we did get one false-ish diff: it posted a change that was a no-op reorder. can we normalize ordering / diff semantics?

Jacob Stein: yep that’s on our list. current diff is structural but still catches some ordering noise. we can canonicalize JSON + ignore known order-only paths.

Miles Thornton: observed region confusion once: bot posted us-east deploys for an eu-west incident. suspect the incident metadata had region unset. can bot call that out more loudly?

Rafael Mendes: good catch. we already show “region: unknown”, but we can add a warning banner like “⚠ incident region missing; deploys shown may be incomplete” + point to how to set region in incident template.

Sean Gallagher: also saw a partial failure where metrics backend lagged and the bot posted “saturation collector timed out” (even though saturation disabled for beta?). pls confirm.

Jacob Stein: that’s a bug. it shouldn’t mention saturation collector if disabled. fixing (collector registry shouldn’t render disabled sections).

SRE Oncall: overall: noise level acceptable. biggest win is linking the right dashboards/runbooks directly from the bundle. responders stopped asking “what’s the deploy link?” in-thread.

Talia Benson: thanks all. I’ll summarize for Neha/leadership as: early wins (time-to-suspect-change), 2 formatting asks (mobile height, warnings when region unknown), 2 correctness asks (diff canonicalization, don’t render disabled collector sections).

Aisha Bello: perfect. keep feedback coming. next week we’ll widen to another rotation if bot error rate stays low.
